name: Kenji
label: Headphone owner weighing lossless
who: I own mid-range headphones and a DAC setup, and I have been comparing Spotify's sound with lossless services like Tidal and Apple Music. I use Spotify daily on AirPods and a car stereo, and I want to know if lossless is worth paying for.
value_for_money: Mixed: they think hi-fi audio can be worth it with good gear, but many doubt it is worth extra cost on everyday setups. They feel Spotify's 320 kbps is good enough for most people, and they see Tidal's higher tiers as expensive for what they hear.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: the everyday convenience and the fact that 320 kbps sounds fine for portable listening. What would push them elsewhere: lossless audio becoming a clear difference they can hear with their gear, which made them test Tidal and Apple Music.
pain_points: Competitors offer lossless for similar prices
Hard to hear the difference on their setup
Higher hi-fi tiers on other services cost more
likes: 320 kbps is good enough for most listening
Convenient on AirPods and in the car
reasons_to_stay: They use Spotify daily on AirPods and in the car, and they think 320 kbps is more than enough for everyday listening. They keep it because the convenience matters more to them than lossless quality, which they are not sure they can hear on their gear.
tone: Analytical and measured, comparing specs and setups and giving reasons for each claim.
